summary: Enhance your corporate governance skills with our Risk-Based Approaches Training. Learn to identify and manage risks effectively for better decision-making.
lede: Corporate governance and risk management training helps governance, risk, compliance, and audit professionals turn material risks into clear oversight priorities. It develops practical skills in assessing risk, setting risk appetite, and mapping control ownership and assurance coverage. Participants also create decision-focused reports that communicate key risk indicators to board and executive decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This risk-based corporate governance course is designed for professionals who must connect strategic risk, board oversight, controls, compliance, assurance, and executive reporting.
prerequisites: Experience: Intermediate to advanced professional exposure to governance, risk, compliance, control, audit, or board operations is expected. Technology: Bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel. Microsoft Power BI Desktop is recommended for the dashboard lab, with a spreadsheet alternative available. No programming, specialist analytics platform, or AI model development is required. Preparation: You may bring anonymized governance policies, risk registers, committee mandates, assurance plans, and board reports for guided application.
